# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Domain: tau2-bench airline. Runtime reader: aws/gpt-oss-120b (mid-capability). Parent = seed
(val reward 0.100, 1 passing task 12, 9 failing). This is iteration 1 (no prior iterations).
Every failure is a DB-state mismatch on a WRITE action. I read all 9 failing traces, clustered
them by root cause, and shipped one fix per cluster passing REAL/SAFE/VERIFIED. I preferred CODE
(deterministic tool enforcement) over prose for behavioral/rule-violation/capability clusters.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Action stall — narrate the write, never call the tool (or don't retry after a fixable error) | 8, 25, 40 | Agent prints a summary, user confirms + ###STOP###, but the write tool is never called. Task 25 also mis-summed payment ($299 vs $375) then described the fix instead of re-calling. | BEHAVIORAL + CAPABILITY-GAP | prompt execution-discipline rules + book_reservation payment auto-resolve (code) |
| 2 | Wrong reservation selected | 17, 22 | User named a trip by route/city; agent acted on a non-matching reservation instead of the described one. No one-call way to list a user's reservations by route. | CAPABILITY-GAP | new `list_reservations` tool (code) + lookup-by-route prompt rule |
| 3 | Cancelled an already-flown reservation | 37 | Agent cancelled NQNU5R whose flights (05-13/14) are before current date 05-15 → an EXTRA wrong write. Gold has NO cancel; only the M20IZO upgrade was correct. | RULE-VIOLATION | in-body guard on cancel_reservation (code) |
| 4 | Passenger update dropped/mis-set the full list | 40 (+17,22) | update_reservation_passengers REPLACES the whole list; agent must include unchanged passengers after reading current details. | KNOWLEDGE | prompt procedure rule |
| 5 | Refund/charge amount mis-communicated | 11 | Agent reported an amount computed from current search prices, not the tool's actual payment_history delta. | KNOWLEDGE | prompt rule: report payment_history delta |
| — | Should-cancel basic-economy | 19 | Gold cancels a basic-economy reservation; the safe general trigger isn't determinable from the trace. | — | deliberately skipped |
| — | max_steps null | 23 | Rollout hit the step cap; uninformative zero. | — | skipped (infra) |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3 | in-body guard | tools.py `cancel_reservation` | Raise if any `flight.date < self._get_datetime()[:10]`. General "already flown → cannot cancel, transfer instead" per policy. | Yes — fires only on past-dated flights; task 12 doesn't cancel; future-dated reservations unaffected. |
| 1 | in-body computation + actionable error | tools.py `book_reservation` | If payment amounts ≠ total_price: single method → set it to total; one credit card among several → credit absorbs the remainder. Re-sync `payment_history` to adjusted amounts. Else raise a directive error naming the exact total. | Yes — fires only on a sum-mismatch; no passing task books; correct splits untouched. |
| 2 | new READ/loop tool | tools.py `list_reservations(user_id)` | Loops the user's reservations → compact route/date/cabin/passenger summaries in ONE call so the model matches by route instead of guessing. | Yes — purely additive read-only tool. |
| 1 | prompt (procedure + 2 worked examples) | policy.md "How to execute write actions" | Confirm ONCE, then the very next output MUST be the write call; retry in-turn after a fixable error; never claim success without a returned call. | Yes — loosens no refuse/deny rule; task 12 already confirmed-once-then-acted. |
| 2 | prompt rule | policy.md "Finding the right reservation" | Use list_reservations and match origin/destination/date; never assume the first reservation. | Yes — only triggers when no reservation ID was given (additive). |
| 4 | prompt rule | policy.md "Change passengers" | Pass the FULL passenger list (get_reservation_details first); edit only the requested passenger(s). | Yes — additive knowledge. |
| 5 | prompt rule | policy.md Modify→Payment | Report the exact charge/refund from the returned payment_history newest entry, not a search-price estimate. | Yes — additive; task 12 is a baggage update, unaffected. |

## Verify-the-fix (trace targeted → what the guard/computation/new-tool does on those inputs)
- cancel_reservation (task 37): NQNU5R flights set to 05-13/14 → RAISES "already departed"; future-dated reservations (05-16/17, 05-28) → NO raise. Blast radius: only past-dated cancels.
- book_reservation (task 25/8): gift 128 + credit 50 vs total 375 → credit auto-set to 247 (= gold split); single certificate at wrong amount → set to total; correct 128+247 → unchanged; two non-credit methods with wrong sum → still RAISES the actionable error. payment_history re-synced to charged amounts (verified stored amounts match adjusted, not the pre-adjust 999/171).
- list_reservations (task 17/22): "omar_rossi_1241" → returns FQ8APE (the gold reservation) alongside the others, each with origin/destination/dates/cabin/pax. tau2 builds the JSON schema; output is JSON-serializable.
- Registration: all 15 tools still register (names verified); get_reservation_details and other tools unchanged.

## Process & features used
- Subagents / worktrees / parallel: serial (single agent). Diagnosis via a small trace parser (user turns + agent tool calls + gold action_checks + feedback) and controlled tool-body runs in the tau2 venv (`/vol/home/skillberry/.cache/capevolve-ci/venv-skillberry-tau2/bin/python3`). NOTE: eval uses task-specific DB states (task 37 moves NQNU5R to the past; task 25 re-quotes to 375) which differ from base get_db(); I verified LOGIC against controlled inputs, not the exact eval DB.
- Prior iterations read from ./prior_iterations/ + ./RUNMAP.md: none — first iteration; LEDGER/JOURNAL/INSIGHTS all empty.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- cancel already-flown guard — clean, high-confidence, prevents an extra wrong write; bounded to past-dated flights.
- book_reservation payment auto-resolve — turns a common arithmetic stall into a deterministic success matching gold's canonical "credit card absorbs remainder" split; re-syncs payment_history.
- list_reservations — additive read tool that structurally fixes wrong-reservation selection.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- Task 19: gold cancels a basic-economy reservation but the general trigger isn't safely determinable from the trace — a global "cancel basic economy" rule would be an unbounded decision change and risk other tasks. Left for a future iteration that can inspect the task DB / flight statuses.
- Task 23: max_steps null zero — an infra/step-cap artifact, not a policy or tool signal.
